name: Knott's Fireman's BBQ Open-Pit Flamed Half Chicken & Baked Potato
whyItWorks: Roasted over giant open-air wood pits right in Ghost Town. Half chicken seasoned with mild herbs, paired with an Idaho baked potato. Unbreaded, lean, and high in protein.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Flamed Half Chicken with a plain baked potato (eat the soft inside flesh with butter, skip potato skin).
